n : undefined;\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nexport default async function handler(req, res) {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    if (req.method !== 'POST') return res.status(405).send('Method not allowed');\\\\\\\\n    const { email } = req.body || {};\\\\\\\\n    if (!email) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing email' });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 1) poslední metriky pro daný e-mail\\\\\\\\n    const { data: rows, error } = await supabaseServer\\\\\\\\n      .from('body_metrics')\\\\\\\\n      .select('*')\\\\\\\\n      .eq('email', email)\\\\\\\\n      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })\\\\\\\\n      .limit(1);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if (error) throw error;\\\\\\\\n    if (!rows?.length) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'No metrics for email' });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const bm = rows[0];\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 2) prompt do modelu\\\\\\\\n    const user = &#96;\\\\\\\\nKlient:\\\\\\\\n- Jméno: ${bm.name || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Pohlaví: ${bm.gender || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Věk: ${bm.age || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Výška: ${bm.height_cm || '—'} cm\\\\\\\\n- Váha: ${bm.weight_kg || '—'} kg\\\\\\\\n- Aktivita: ${bm.activity || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Stres: ${bm.stress_level || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Práce: ${bm.occupation || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Cíl: ${bm.goal || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Frekvence cvičení: ${bm.freq_choice || bm.weekly_sessions || '—'}× týdně\\\\\\\\nVýpočty:\\\\\\\\n- BMI: ${bm.bmi ?? n : undefined;\\\\\\\\n}\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\nexport default async function handler(req, res) {\\\\\\\\n  try {\\\\\\\\n    if (req.method !== 'POST') return res.status(405).send('Method not allowed');\\\\\\\\n    const { email } = req.body || {};\\\\\\\\n    if (!email) return res.status(400).json({ error: 'Missing email' });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 1) poslední metriky pro daný e-mail\\\\\\\\n    const { data: rows, error } = await supabaseServer\\\\\\\\n      .from('body_metrics')\\\\\\\\n      .select('*')\\\\\\\\n      .eq('email', email)\\\\\\\\n      .order('created_at', { ascending: false })\\\\\\\\n      .limit(1);\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    if (error) throw error;\\\\\\\\n    if (!rows?.length) return res.status(404).json({ error: 'No metrics for email' });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const bm = rows[0];\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 2) prompt do modelu\\\\\\\\n    const user = &#96;\\\\\\\\nKlient:\\\\\\\\n- Jméno: ${bm.name || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Pohlaví: ${bm.gender || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Věk: ${bm.age || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Výška: ${bm.height_cm || '—'} cm\\\\\\\\n- Váha: ${bm.weight_kg || '—'} kg\\\\\\\\n- Aktivita: ${bm.activity || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Stres: ${bm.stress_level || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Práce: ${bm.occupation || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Cíl: ${bm.goal || '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Frekvence cvičení: ${bm.freq_choice || bm.weekly_sessions || '—'}× týdně\\\\\\\\nVýpočty:\\\\\\\\n- BMI: ${bm.bmi ?? '—'}\\\\\\\\n- TDEE: ${bm.tdee ?? '—'}\\\\\\\\n- Kalorický cíl: ${bm.calories_target ?? '—'}\\\\\\\\nPoznámky: ${bm.notes || '—'}\\\\\\\\nPožadavek: Připrav týdenní plán dle výše, dodrž strukturu HTML a buď stručný, ale konkrétní (gramáže).&#96;;\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const completion = await openai.chat.completions.create({\\\\\\\\n      model: 'gpt-4o-mini',\\\\\\\\n      temperature: 0.6,\\\\\\\\n      messages: [\\\\\\\\n        { role: 'system', content: SYS },\\\\\\\\n        { role: 'user', content: user }\\\\\\\\n      ]\\\\\\\\n    });\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    const planHtml = completion.choices?.[0]?.message?.content?.trim();\\\\\\\\n    if (!planHtml) throw new Error('Empty plan');\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 3) výpočet maker (bez self-referencí)\\\\\\\\n    let macros = null;\\\\\\\\n    if (bm.calories_target) {\\\\\\\\n      const protein_g = Math.round((asNum(bm.weight_kg) || 70) * 1.8);\\\\\\\\n      const kc = asNum(bm.calories_target) || 2200;\\\\\\\\n      const fat_g = Math.round(kc * 0.25 / 9);\\\\\\\\n      const carbs_g = Math.round((kc - protein_g * 4 - fat_g * 9) / 4);\\\\\\\\n      macros = { protein_g, fat_g, carbs_g };\\\\\\\\n    }\\\\\\\\n\\\\\\\\n    // 4) Bezpečná hodnota plan_type (VŽDY pošleme nějakou hodnotu)\\\\\\\\n    // Použijeme cíl z body_metrics, jinak 'general'.\\\\\\\\n    const plan_type = bm.goal || 'general'; // např. React Components\\\\n\\\\n**Framework:** Next.js 14.2.5 with React 18.3.1\\\\n\\\\n**Components Found:**\\\\n- &#96;components/Header.js&#96; - Navigation header with links\\\\n- &#96;components/Footer.js&#96; - Site footer with links\\\\n- &#96;components/Pricing.tsx&#96; - Pricing display component (TypeScript)\\\\n\\\\n**Component Structure:**\\\\n- Simple functional components\\\\n- Uses Next.js &#96;Link&#96; for navigation\\\\n- Styled with CSS-in-JS (&#96;&lt;style jsx&gt;&#96;) and Tailwind CSS classes\\\\n- No component library detected (custom styling)\\\\n\\\\n### 2. Main Pages/Views\\\\n\\\\n**Pages Directory Structure** (Next.js Pages Router):\\\\n- &#96;pages/index.js&#96; - Landing page with hero section and \\\\\\\"Jak to funguje\\\\\\\"\\\\n- &#96;pages/pricing.js&#96; - Pricing/registration form page\\\\n- &#96;pages/register.js&#96; - Registration form (alternative)\\\\n- &#96;pages/signup.js&#96; - User account signup (Supabase auth)\\\\n- &#96;pages/onboarding.js&#96; - Onboarding questionnaire\\\\n- &#96;pages/start.js&#96; - Start program landing page (uses framer-motion)\\\\n- &#96;pages/training.js&#96; - 1:1 training booking page\\\\n- &#96;pages/admin.js&#96; - Admin dashboard (protected by token query param)\\\\n- &#96;pages/_app.js&#96; - App wrapper (minimal)\\\\n- &#96;pages/_document.js&#96; - Document wrapper with SEO meta tags\\\\n\\\\n**Page Flow:**\\\\n1. Landing (&#96;/&#96;) → Pricing (&#96;/pricing&#96;) → Registration (&#96;/register&#96; or &#96;/onboarding&#96;)\\\\n2. Signup (&#96;/signup&#96;) → Email confirmation → Dashboard (not implemented yet)\\\\n3. Training booking (&#96;/training&#96;) requires authentication\\\\n\\\\n### 3. API Routes / Backend Logic\\\\n\\\\n**API Endpoints** (&#96;pages/api/&#96;):\\\\n- &#96;api/body-metrics.js&#96; - POST endpoint for saving user metrics and triggering plan generation\\\\n- &#96;api/generate-plan.js&#96; - POST endpoint for generating AI fitness plans (OpenAI)\\\\n- &#96;api/sessions.js&#96; - POST endpoint for booking 1:1 training sessions (requires auth)\\\\n\\\\n**Backend Services** (&#96;lib/&#96;):\\\\n- &#96;lib/supabaseClient.js&#96; - Client-side Supabase client (anon key)\\\\n- &#96;lib/supabaseServer.js&#96; - Server-side Supabase client (service role)\\\\n- &#96;lib/openai.js&#96; - OpenAI client configuration\\\\n- &#96;lib/mail.js&#96; - Email service using Nodemailer (Gmail SMTP)\\\\n- &#96;lib/generatePlan.js&#96; - Core AI plan generation logic\\\\n- &#96;lib/pricing.ts&#96; - Pricing configuration data\\\\n\\\\n**Key Backend Features:**\\\\n- Supabase for database and authentication\\\\n- OpenAI GPT-4o-mini for generating fitness/nutrition plans\\\\n- Email notifications via Nodemailer (Gmail)\\\\n- Optional Make.com webhook integration\\\\n\\\\n### 4. State Management Patterns\\\\n\\\\n**State Management Approach:** Local component state only\\\\n\\\\n**Patterns Identified:**\\\\n- React &#96;useState&#96; hooks in all pages\\\\n- No global state management (no Redux, Zustand, Context API)\\\\n- No shared state between components\\\\n- Form state managed locally in each page component\\\\n- Router state via &#96;useRouter&#96; from Next.js for query params\\\\n\\\\n**State Examples:**\\\\n- &#96;pages/pricing.js&#96; - 15+ useState hooks for form fields\\\\n- &#96;pages/onboarding.js&#96; - Multiple useState hooks for questionnaire\\\\n- &#96;pages/training.js&#96; - Simple state for duration selection\\\\n- &#96;pages/signup.js&#96; - Email/password state\\\\n\\\\n**Note:** No centralized state management detected. Each page manages its own state independently.\\\\n\\\\n### 5. Authentication/Authorization Logic\\\\n\\\\n**Authentication Provider:** Supabase Auth\\\\n\\\\n**Auth Implementation:**\\\\n\\\\n1. **Client-Side Auth** (&#96;lib/supabaseClient.js&#96;):\\\\n   - Uses &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL&#96; and &#96;NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY&#96;\\\\n   - Used in &#96;pages/signup.js&#96; for user registration\\\\n\\\\n2. **Server-Side Auth** (&#96;lib/supabaseServer.js&#96;):\\\\n   - Uses &#96;SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY&#96; for privileged operations\\\\n   - Used in API routes for database operations\\\\n\\\\n3. **Auth Endpoints:**\\\\n   - &#96;pages/signup.js&#96; - User registration via &#96;supabase.auth.signUp()&#96;\\\\n   - &#96;pages/api/sessions.js&#96; - Protected endpoint requiring JWT Bearer token\\\\n     - Validates token via &#96;supabaseServer.auth.getUser(token)&#96;\\\\n     - Returns 401 if unauthorized\\\\n\\\\n4. **Authorization Patterns:**\\\\n   - **Admin Page** (&#96;pages/admin.js&#96;): Protected via query parameter (&#96;?key=ADMIN_TOKEN&#96;)\\\\n     - Uses &#96;getServerSideProps&#96; to check &#96;ADMIN_TOKEN&#96; env variable\\\\n   - **Training Sessions** (&#96;pages/api/sessions.js&#96;): Requires authenticated user\\\\n     - Validates JWT from Authorization header\\\\n     - Associates session with &#96;user_id&#96;\\\\n\\\\n5. **Auth Flow:**\\\\n   - User signs up → Email confirmation → (Login page not found in codebase)\\\\n   - Protected routes check JWT token in API calls\\\\n   - No client-side auth guards detected (no middleware or protected route wrappers)\\\\n\\\\n**Missing Auth Features:**\\\\n- No login page found\\\\n- No logout functionality\\\\n- No session persistence checks on client-side\\\\n- No protected route middleware\\\\n\\\\n### Application Features Summary\\\\n\\\\n**Core Functionality:**\\\\n1. User registration and onboarding\\\\n2. Body metrics collection (height, weight, age, activity level, etc.)\\\\n3. AI-powered fitness/nutrition plan generation (OpenAI GPT-4o-mini)\\\\n4. Email delivery of generated plans\\\\n5. Training session booking (1:1 sessions)\\\\n6. Admin dashboard for viewing metrics\\\\n\\\\n**Tech Stack:**\\\\n- **Frontend:** Next.js 14, React 18, Tailwind CSS (partial), framer-motion (in start.js)\\\\n- **Backend:** Next.js API routes, Supabase (database + auth)\\\\n- **AI:** OpenAI GPT-4o-mini\\\\n- **Email:** Nodemailer with Gmail SMTP\\\\n- **Database:** Supabase (PostgreSQL)\\\\n\\\\n**Database Tables (inferred from code):**\\\\n- &#96;body_metrics&#96; - User body measurements and goals\\\\n- &#96;ai_generated_plans&#96; - Generated fitness/nutrition plans\\\\n- &#96;sessions&#96; - Training session bookings\\\\n- &#96;users&#96; - Supabase auth users (managed by Supabase)\\\\n\\\\n**Architecture Pattern:**\\\\n- Serverless Next.js application\\\\n- API routes handle backend logic\\\\n- Supabase handles database and auth\\\\n- Stateless API design (no session storage)\\\\n- Component-based UI with local state management\\\\n\\\\nThe application follows a simple, straightforward architecture suitable for an MVP fitness coaching platform with AI-generated plans.\\\"}\"},\"status\":\"completed\",\"context\":{\"composers\":[],\"selectedCommits\":[],\"selectedPullRequests\":[],\"selectedImages\":[],\"folderSelections\":[],\"fileSelections\":[],\"selections\":[],\"terminalSelections\":[],\"selectedDocs\":[],\"externalLinks\":[],\"cursorRules\":[],\"cursorCommands\":[],\"gitPRDiffSelections\":[],\"subagentSelections\":[],\"browserSelections\":[],\"mentions\":{\"composers\":{},\"selectedCommits\":{},\"selectedPullRequests\":{},\"gitDiff\":[],\"gitDiffFromBranchToMain\":[],\"selectedImages\":{},\"folderSelections\":{},\"fileSelections\":{},\"terminalFiles\":{},\"selections\":{},\"terminalSelections\":{},\"selectedDocs\":{},\"externalLinks\":{},\"diffHistory\":[],\"cursorRules\":{},\"cursorCommands\":{},\"uiElementSelections\":[],\"consoleLogs\":[],\"ideEditorsState\":[],\"gitPRDiffSelections\":{},\"subagentSelections\":{},\"browserSelections\":{}}},\"generatingBubbleIds\":[],\"isReadingLongFile\":false,\"codeBlockData\":{},\"originalFileStates\":{},\"newlyCreatedFiles\":[],\"newlyCreatedFolders\":[],\"createdAt\":1771454800751,\"hasChangedContext\":false,\"activeTabsShouldBeReactive\":true,\"capabilities\":[{\"type\":30,\"data\":{}},{\"type\":15,\"data\":{\"bubbleDataMap\":\"{}\"}}],\"name\":\"Analyze   "plan": "# Automatická registrace uživatele při vyplnění START formuláře\n\n## Přehled změn\n\nPři odeslání formuláře na &#96;/start&#96; se automaticky:\n1. Odešle email s plánem + informací o účtu\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;mermaid\nflowchart LR\n    A[START Formulář] --&gt; B[API: body-metrics]\n    B --&gt; C{Email existuje?}\n    C --&gt;|Ne| D[Vytvoř uživatele]\n    C --&gt;|Ano| E[Použij existujícího]\n    D --&gt; F[Ulož body_metrics s user_id]\n    E --&gt; F\n    F --&gt; G[Generuj AI plán]\n    G --&gt; H[Odešli email]\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Implementace\n\n### 1. Upravit API endpoint [&#96;pages/api/body-metrics.js&#96;](pages/api/body-metrics.js)\n\nPřidat logiku pro automatickou registraci:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// Před uložením body_metrics\nlet userId = null;\n\nif (payload.email) {\n  // Zkontroluj, zda uživatel již existuje\n  const { data: existingUsers } = await supabaseServer.auth.admin.listUsers();\n  const existingUser = existingUsers?.users?.find(u =&gt; u.email === payload.email);\n  \n  if (existingUser) {\n    userId = existingUser.id;\n  } else {\n    // Vytvoř nového uživatele\n    const { data: newUser, error } = await supabaseServer.auth.admin.createUser({\n      email: payload.email,\n      email_confirm: true,  // Auto-potvrdit email\n      user_metadata: { \n        name: payload.name,\n        registered_via: 'start_form'\n      }\n    });\n    \n    if (!error &amp;&amp; newUser?.user) {\n      userId = newUser.user.id;\n    }\n  }\n}\n\n// Uložit do body_metrics s user_id\npayload.user_id = userId;\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n### 2. Rozšířit email notifikaci [&#96;lib/mail.js&#96;](lib/mail.js)\n\nPřidat informaci o vytvořeném účtu do emailu s plánem:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// V emailu přidat sekci:\n&lt;p&gt;Tvůj účet byl automaticky vytvořen. (Volitelné) Vytvořit login stránku\n\nAktuálně chybí &#96;/pages/login.js&#96;. Pro kompletní flow doporučuji přidat:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\n// pages/login.js - přihlášení přes magic link\nconst { error } = await supabase.auth.signInWithOtp({\n  email: email,\n  options: { emailRedirectTo: &#96;${window.location.origin}/dashboard&#96; }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n---\n\n## Klíčové soubory k úpravě\n\n| Soubor | Změna |\n|--------|-------|\n| [&#96;pages/api/body-metrics.js&#96;](pages/api/body-metrics.js) | Přidat auto-registraci uživatele |\n| [&#96;lib/mail.js&#96;](lib/mail.js) | Rozšířit email o info k účtu |\n| &#96;pages/login.js&#96; (nový) | Přihlašovací stránka (volitelné) |\n\n---\n\n## Supabase Admin API\n\nPro vytvoření uživatele použijeme &#96;supabaseServer.auth.admin.createUser()&#96;:\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;javascript\nconst { data, error } = await supabaseServer.auth.admin.createUser({\n  email: 'user@example.com',\n  email_confirm: true,\n  user_metadata: { name: 'Jan Novák' }\n});\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\n- &#96;email_confirm: true&#96; - účet je ihned aktivní bez potvrzovacího emailu\n- &#96;user_metadata&#96; - ukládá dodatečné informace o uživateli\n\n---\n\n## Bezpečnostní poznámky\n\n- Používáme &#96;SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY&#96; (admin oprávnění) - pouze na serveru\n- Kontrola existence uživatele před vytvořením zabraňuje duplicitám\n- Uživatel se může přihlásit přes magic link (bezpečné bez hesla)\n",

## Dokončené změny

- Přidán parametr `isNewUser` do funkce `generatePlanForEmail()`

- Kompletně přepracovaná emailová šablona s moderním designem
- Pro nové uživatele se zobrazí sekce s informací o vytvořeném účtu
- Tlačítko pro přihlášení do aplikace
- Personalizovaný předmět emailu pro nové uživatele

### 4. [`pages/login.js`](pages/login.js) (nový soubor)
- Přihlašovací stránka s magic link funkcionalitou
- Moderní design konzistentní se zbytkem aplikace
- Po odeslání zobrazí potvrzení s instrukcemi
- Odkaz na registraci pro nové uživatele

### 5. [`components/Header.js`](components/Header.js)
- Aktualizovány navigační odkazy
- "Přihlášení" nyní směřuje na `/login`
- "Registrace" směřuje na `/start`

## Flow pro uživatele

```
START formulář → API body-metrics → Automatická registrace → Uložení metrik 
→ Generování AI plánu → Email s plánem + info o účtu → Uživatel může kliknout 
na "Přihlásit se" → Magic link email → Přihlášení do aplikace
```

Modifiers are everything that don't fit that definition—allowing you to change the format of the response (e.g., returning a CSV string).\n\nModifiers must be specified after filters. Some modifiers only apply for queries that return rows (e.g.,&#96;select()&#96; or&#96;rpc()&#96; on a function that returns a table response).\n\n---\n\n## Return data after inserting\n\n&#96;select(columns?)&#96;\n\nPerform a SELECT on the query result.\n\nBy default,&#96;.insert()&#96;,&#96;.update()&#96;,&#96;.upsert()&#96;, and&#96;.delete()&#96; do not return modified rows. By calling this method, modified rows are returned in&#96;data&#96;.\n\n### Parameters\n\ncolumns\n\nOptional\n\nQuery\n\nThe columns to retrieve, separated by commas\n\nWith &#96;upsert()&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1const { data, error } = await supabase2  .from('characters')3  .upsert({ id: 1, name: 'Han Solo' })4  .select()\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nData source\n\nResponse\n\n---\n\n## Order the results\n\n&#96;order(column, options?)&#96;\n\n### Parameters\n\ncolumnOne of the following options\n\nDetails\n\nOption 1ColumnName\n\nOption 2string\n\noptions\n\nOptional\n\nobject\n\nDetails\n\n### Return Type\n\nthis\n\nWith &#96;select()&#96;On a referenced tableOrder parent table by a referenced table\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1const { data, error } = await supabase2  .from('characters')3  .select('id, name')4  .order('id', { ascending: false })\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nData source\n\nResponse\n\n---\n\n## Limit the number of rows returned\n\n&#96;limit(count, options)&#96;\n\nLimit the query result by&#96;count&#96;.\n\n### Parameters\n\ncountnumber\n\nThe maximum number of rows to return\n\noptionsobject\n\nNamed parameters\n\nDetails\n\n### Return Type\n\nthis\n\nWith &#96;select()&#96;On a referenced table\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1const { data, error } = await supabase2  .from('characters')3  .select('name')4  .limit(1)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nData source\n\nResponse\n\n---\n\n## Limit the query to a range\n\n&#96;range(from, to, options)&#96;\n\nLimit the query result by starting at an offset&#96;from&#96; and ending at the offset&#96;to&#96;. Only records within this range are returned. This respects the query order and if there is no order clause the range could behave unexpectedly. The&#96;from&#96; and&#96;to&#96; values are 0-based and inclusive:&#96;range(1, 3)&#96; will include the second, third and fourth rows of the query.\n\n### Parameters\n\nfromnumber\n\nThe starting index from which to limit the result\n\ntonumber\n\nThe last index to which to limit the result\n\noptionsobject\n\nNamed parameters\n\nDetails\n\n### Return Type\n\nthis\n\nWith &#96;select()&#96;\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1const { data, error } = await supabase2  .from('characters')3  .select('name')4  .range(0, 1)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nData source\n\nResponse\n\n---\n\n## Set an abort signal\n\n&#96;abortSignal(signal)&#96;\n\nSet the AbortSignal for the fetch request.\n\nYou can use this to set a timeout for the request.\n\n### Parameters\n\nsignalAbortSignal\n\nThe AbortSignal to use for the fetch request\n\n### Return Type\n\nthis\n\nAborting requests in-flightSet a timeout\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1const ac = new AbortController()2ac.abort()3const { data, error } = await supabase4  .from('very_big_table')5  .select()6  .abortSignal(ac.signal)\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nResponse\n\nNotes\n\n---\n\n## Retrieve one row of data\n\n&#96;single()&#96;\n\nReturn&#96;data&#96; as a string in CSV format.\n\nReturn data as CSV\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1const { data, error } = await supabase2  .from('characters')3  .select()4  .csv()\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nData source\n\nResponse\n\nNotes\n\n---\n\n## Override type of successful response\n\n&#96;returns()&#96;\n\nOverride the type of the returned&#96;data&#96;.\n\n- Deprecated: use overrideTypes method instead\n\nOverride type of successful responseOverride type of object response\n\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n1const { data } = await supabase2  .from('countries')3  .select()4  .returns&lt;Array&lt;MyType&gt;&gt;()\n&#96;&#96;&#96;\n\nResponse\n\n---\n\n## Partially override or replace type of successful response\n\n&#96;overrideTypes()&#96;\n\nOverride the type of the returned&#96;data&#96;
